# OverCue Desktop 2.2.18 for Mac

- Add Normalize volume for exported USB tracks, independently of stem preparation or together in one flow. Targets −18 LUFS while preserving dynamics and allowing for peak headroom.
- Support MP3, PCM WAV, AIFF and FLAC normalization while preserving track timing, cues and beatgrids. Computer originals stay unchanged; adjusted USB copies are not backed up.
- Keep existing stems balanced with volume adjustments and account for normalization when stems are added later.
- Show USB tracks and playlists sooner, with stem verification continuing in the background and clear loading progress.
